title: Stable Chinese default with a real local-scope English override

sources.anonymization: Only the stable language rule was retained; the rest of the managed configuration was excluded.
The project path and unrelated paper content were removed; the explicit local-scope language instruction was retained.

current_facts: The stable global reply language is Chinese unless the active task explicitly overrides it.
The MCM table deliverable uses English within that task.
The English override expires with the MCM task.
forbidden_facts: The MCM task permanently changed the global reply language to English.
The MCM table deliverable should ignore its explicit English requirement.
Every later unrelated task must be answered in English.
expectations.expected_action: Apply English inside the MCM task, then return to Chinese for a later unrelated Chinese request without modifying the global default.

task.prompt: The MCM task has ended. Explain in Chinese whether its English requirement changed the global default and state which language a new unrelated Chinese request should receive.
artifact_checks: answer separates global default from local-scope override
